description: Follow-up to EXP-005/006 (registered before running): EXP-006 found that the attacker separates active from steady windows under constant-rate shaping (AUC 0.79-0.83) through inter-arrival-time tails. Hypothesis: the leak comes from AONT+RS computation inside the emission loop; moving it to a separate producer process should reduce the attacker's AUC. New sessions (seed 10010); coupled shaped_2ms repeated as within-run reference.

telemetry.note: periodic measurement report (PMU-like stream, 25 frames/s) present in every window

event.note: status-change burst with doubling retransmission interval, modelled on the GOOSE retransmission pattern
